verification.title: How drivers are verified
verification.intro: Every driver bidding on this network is an approved individual carrier. Nothing is visible to bid on until that approval is granted. Here is exactly what we ask for, what we check, and what happens to your documents afterwards.

items.title: Proof of identity
items.desc: A valid identity document, plus the licence category covering the vehicle you intend to drive.

items.title: A SIRET number
items.desc: A sole trader carrying goods for hire in France has one. We do not ask for a KBIS extract — an auto-entrepreneur does not have one, and requiring it would exclude most of the drivers this network is built for.

items.title: Transport insurance
items.desc: Cover for goods in transit, in your own name, valid on the date you apply and kept valid afterwards.

items.title: One vehicle
items.desc: Registration, capacity and type for the vehicle you will use. One is enough — an offer names the vehicle that will do the job, so we need the one you are actually bidding with, not a fleet.

items.title: You apply
items.desc: Create an account, complete the carrier application and upload your documents. You can save and come back; nothing is submitted until you say so.

items.title: We check
items.desc: An operator reviews the documents against the requirements above and confirms the SIRET and the insurance are live and in your name.

items.title: You are approved
items.desc: Approval opens the job board. From that point you can see escalated jobs and bid on price, arrival time and vehicle.

items.title: You stay current
items.desc: Documents carry expiry dates. We track them and warn you before one lapses, so approval does not quietly go stale.

privacy.title: What happens to your documents
privacy.body: Identity and compliance documents are held in private storage. They are never served from a public address, never attached to a job, and never shown to another carrier or to the client whose delivery you are carrying. Only operators reviewing your application can open them. Bank details are held by our payment provider — we keep only the last four digits so you can recognise your own account.
privacy.expiry: If a document expires and is not replaced, the account is suspended rather than left to bid with cover that no longer exists. Replacing the document restores it.

auctionHouses.title: For auction houses and their buyers
auctionHouses.intro: Expeditoo is the carrier network behind Expedion. You never post here and you never manage a driver here — you accept a quote in Expedion, and this network exists so that a job nobody has picked up still gets collected.

flow.title: How a delivery reaches this network

items.title: The quote is accepted
items.desc: Your buyer accepts and pays a transport quote inside Expedion. That is the whole commitment on their side — the price is fixed at that moment.

items.title: The clock starts
items.desc: If no driver has taken the job within 48 hours, it escalates automatically. Nothing needs to be chased and nobody has to notice.

items.title: Drivers bid it down
items.desc: Approved carriers compete on price, collection time and vehicle. What the buyer already paid is the ceiling, never a target.

items.title: An operator awards it
items.desc: The cheapest bid does not win automatically. An operator compares price against arrival time and vehicle and selects the one that will actually work.

items.title: The price does not move
items.desc: Escalation never asks the buyer for more money. The amount agreed in Expedion is what they pay, whatever the job takes to fill.

items.title: Nobody leaves your product
items.desc: Status flows back to Expedion — awarded, collected, in transit, delivered. Your buyer follows it where they started.

items.title: Only verified carriers
items.desc: Every bidder has passed identity, SIRET, insurance and vehicle checks before seeing the job at all.

items.title: Paid on delivery, not before
items.desc: Funds are authorised when a driver is awarded the job and captured only once delivery is confirmed.

notMarketplace.title: What this is not
notMarketplace.body: This is not a marketplace where you shop for transport, and there is no goods auction here — the only auction is the reverse one on price between carriers. There is no house-facing job form and nothing to log into. If you want to arrange transport, that happens in Expedion; this network is what stands behind it when a job goes unclaimed.

sections.title: Purpose of the site
paragraphs: expeditoo.com is the carrier-side platform of the Expedion group. It lets verified individual carriers bid on transport jobs escalated from Expedion, and lets operators award those jobs.
The site does not sell goods and hosts no auction of goods. The only auction it operates is a reverse auction on the price of a transport job, between carriers.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The structure of the site, its text, graphics, logos and software are the property of the publisher or are used with permission. Reproduction or reuse of any part, by any means, without prior written consent is prohibited.
The EXPEDITOO and Expedion names and logos are the property of the group. Use of them without authorisation is not permitted.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: Processing of personal data is described in the privacy policy, which sets out what is collected, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights under the GDPR.
Requests relating to your data go to privacy@expeditoo.com.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The site sets only the cookies needed for it to work — the session that keeps you signed in, and the storage that remembers your language and theme. These require no consent because the site cannot function without them.
No advertising or third-party tracking cookie is set.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The publisher works to keep the information on this site accurate and up to date, but gives no warranty that it is free of error or continuously available.
The publisher operates the platform on which carriers and clients transact. It is not the carrier and does not perform deliveries.

sections.title: Applicable law and mediation
paragraphs: This notice is governed by French law. Any dispute falls to the competent French courts.
In accordance with the French Consumer Code, a consumer may refer a dispute free of charge to a consumer mediator. The mediator appointed by the publisher is named below once designated.
TO BE SUPPLIED — mediator name and address.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The rules that govern the use of expeditoo.com by carriers, operators and anyone else who accesses it.

sections.title: Acceptance
paragraphs: Using expeditoo.com means accepting these terms in full. If you do not accept them, do not use the platform.
We may change these terms. Continuing to use the platform after a change means accepting the amended version.

sections.title: What the service is
paragraphs: Expeditoo is the carrier network of the Expedion group. It publishes transport jobs escalated from Expedion, lets approved carriers bid on them, and lets an operator award one bid.
Expeditoo is not a marketplace for goods. Nothing is sold here, there is no goods auction, and no client posts work here directly — every job on this platform arrives by escalation from Expedion.
items: Publication of escalated transport jobs
Competitive bidding by approved carriers on price, collection time and vehicle
Award of a job by an operator
Execution tracking, proof of delivery and status write-back to Expedion
Payment handling and carrier payouts

sections.title: Accounts and approval
paragraphs: An account is personal. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for everything done under your account, and you must tell us at once if you believe it has been used without your consent.

Bidding requires approval as a carrier. Approval follows a documentary check — identity, SIRET, transport insurance and one vehicle. Approval may be refused, suspended or withdrawn, in particular when a document expires or turns out not to be valid.

sections.title: How a job is awarded
paragraphs: A job carries the amount the client has already paid in Expedion. That amount is a ceiling, not a target: carriers bid below it, and the difference between the amount paid and the winning bid is the platform's margin.
The lowest bid does not win automatically. An operator selects the winning bid, weighing price against collection time, vehicle and the carrier's record. No carrier is entitled to be awarded a job.

sections.title: Carrier obligations
items: Carry out an awarded job yourself, with the vehicle named in your bid
Keep your identity, SIRET, insurance and vehicle information accurate and current
Collect and deliver within the times you committed to, and report a delay as soon as you know of one
Provide proof of delivery when the job is complete
Comply with the law applying to the carriage of goods for hire, including driving time and load rules

sections.title: Payment
paragraphs: Funds are authorised when a job is awarded and held. They are captured when delivery is confirmed, never before.
If a job is cancelled before delivery, the authorisation is released. The platform's commission is deducted at source, and the balance is paid out to the carrier.
The payer is the client who commissioned the job in Expedion. Nothing here creates a payment obligation on an operator personally.

sections.title: Conduct
paragraphs: You agree not to submit false or misleading information, to impersonate another person, to attempt unauthorised access to the platform, or to use it for any unlawful purpose.
Bidding without the intention or means to perform the job, or with a vehicle you do not have, is a breach of these terms.

sections.title: Reviews
paragraphs: After a completed delivery, both sides may leave a review. Reviews must be factual and relate to the delivery. We may remove a review that is abusive, off-topic or plainly false.

sections.title: Suspension
paragraphs: We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, whose documents have lapsed, or where there is reasonable suspicion of fraud. A suspended account cannot bid and its live sessions are ended.
Money already earned on completed deliveries remains payable.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The platform is provided as is. We do not warrant uninterrupted or error-free operation.
Expeditoo is not the carrier. The carriage itself is performed by the carrier awarded the job, under their own insurance and their own legal responsibility.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by French law, and any dispute falls to the competent French courts.
Questions about these terms go to support@expeditoo.com.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What personal data Expeditoo holds, why it holds it, how long for, and the rights you have over it.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The publisher named in the legal notice is the data controller for the processing described here.
For any question or request about your data, write to privacy@expeditoo.com.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Account data — name, email address, telephone number, password (stored hashed, never in the clear)
Carrier compliance data — identity document, SIRET, transport insurance, driving licence category
Vehicle data — registration, type and capacity of the vehicle you bid with
Activity data — bids submitted, jobs awarded, collection and delivery timestamps, proof of delivery
Messages exchanged through the platform, including support conversations
Payment data — held by our payment provider. We store the last four digits of a bank account so you can recognise it, and never a full IBAN
Technical data — IP address and device information, used for security and abuse prevention

sections.title: Why we process it
items: To operate the platform and perform our contract with you — publishing jobs, accepting bids, tracking delivery, paying carriers
To meet our legal obligations — verifying that a carrier may lawfully carry goods for hire, and keeping accounting records
For our legitimate interest in a safe platform — preventing fraud and abuse, and investigating incidents
To notify you about your own activity. Marketing messages, if any, need your consent and can be withdrawn at any time

sections.title: Compliance documents
paragraphs: Identity and compliance documents are treated separately from the rest of your account. They are held in private storage, are never served from a public address, and are never disclosed to another carrier or to a client.
Only operators reviewing an application can open them. They are kept for as long as the account is approved and for the period French law requires afterwards, then deleted.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. It is shared only with the processors that run the service, each bound to act on our instructions:
items: Stripe — payment authorisation, capture and carrier payouts
Supabase — the database holding platform records
Cloudflare R2 — file storage, including private compliance documents
Resend — transactional email
Ably — realtime updates to job and delivery screens
Expedion, our sibling product — delivery status only, so the client who commissioned the job can follow it where they started

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: Account data — for as long as the account exists, then deleted or anonymised
Delivery and payment records — for the accounting retention period French law imposes
Compliance documents — while approval stands, plus the retention period required afterwards
Messages — for as long as the account exists
Technical logs — a rolling period, kept short and used only for security

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR you may ask for access to your data, correction of it, its deletion, a portable copy of it, restriction of processing, or you may object to processing based on our legitimate interest.
items: Write to privacy@expeditoo.com; we answer within one month
You may also complain to the CNIL, the French data protection authority
Deletion is subject to records we are legally obliged to keep, such as accounting records for a completed delivery

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Only the cookies the site needs to work are set: the session that keeps you signed in, and the local storage that remembers your language and theme. No advertising or third-party tracking cookie is set.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Traffic is encrypted in transit. Passwords are hashed. Compliance documents sit in private storage reachable only through an authorised, time-limited request. Sessions can be revoked, and a suspended account's live sessions end rather than surviving until they expire.
No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your data and is likely to present a risk to you, we will tell you and the CNIL as the GDPR requires.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes materially we will say so in the app rather than only editing this page.

q1.question: How do I track my shipment?
q1.answer: You can track your shipment by going to the "Deliveries" section in your dashboard. Click on the specific shipment to view its current status and timeline.

q2.question: How does the auction bidding work?
q2.answer: When you place a bid, you are committing to buy the item if you win. The auction ends when the timer runs out. If a bid is placed in the last few minutes, the timer may extend (soft close) to allow other bidders to respond.

q3.question: Can I cancel a shipment?
q3.answer: You can cancel a shipment request as long as it hasn't been picked up by a driver. Go to the shipment details page and look for the "Cancel" option. Cancellation fees may apply if a driver has already been assigned.

q4.question: How do I contact a seller?
q4.answer: You can message a seller directly from the item listing page or from your "Messages" dashboard. All communication should stay within the platform for your safety.

q5.question: What payment methods are accepted?
q5.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards via our secure payment partner, Stripe. We do not store your card details directly on our servers.
